content: Operating files live in .ai. Chats are copied by copy_chats.py. Journal entries are appended only through organize.py against journal-entry.schema.json.
Each .ai context is one module folder. The checker discovers module.json and does not keep a central list of contexts.
Foreign code is a source. Intake decision is write-here: name the owner, the spec, and a whole-behavior proof, then code it in that module. decision import is rejected by schema/intake.schema.json.

cargo build -p shippin-tech --config build.rustc-wrapper= empty, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1, exited 0 in 2m 15s. target/debug/shippin-tech.exe written 2026-10-29T22:39:50, 168851968 bytes. Default features rocks and enterprise. Build phase exit proof observed.

One Rocks node at D:/localdev/mail-shippin/one-node/rocks, domain example.org, mailbox admin@example.org. SMTP on port 25 queued message 337765459443056640 and local delivery ingested it into INBOX. IMAPS on port 993 selected INBOX and returned the body rocks-mailbox-proof-token-2026-10-29.

afterAgentThought writes the full thinking text to chats reasoning.jsonl as kind thought. preCompact writes kind compaction. The session event keeps the raw payload, including duration_ms. Past thoughts were not on disk, so they cannot be backfilled.

The scale binary writes the existing BlobStore S3 and Coordinator NATS singletons from shippin.tech_SCALE_S3_ENDPOINT, shippin.tech_SCALE_S3_ACCESS_KEY, shippin.tech_SCALE_S3_SECRET_KEY, and shippin.tech_SCALE_NATS_ADDRESS when those singletons are empty. A partial set writes nothing. deployable-product stays in_progress until the Dockerfile.fdb container is started.

scale_two_nodes passed in 16.66s. Tenant A message written on node A was read on node B. Tenant B Mailbox/get returned forbidden. Both nodes redirected JMAP, CalDAV, and CardDAV discovery. cargo build -p shippin-tech exited 0. The scale env unit test passed.

Client sequence is recorded and not started. After shippin.cloud hosts the deployable image: web and phone mailbox on JMAP, CalDAV, and CardDAV. Control plane stays the existing directory and is white-label and enterprise only. Then a separate docs product. Then photos sync and phone backup on urn:ietf:params:jmap:filenode. deployable-product stays in_progress.

UI standard recorded. /admin and /account are rebuilt later with shippin.tech style tokens on an A2UI v0.9.1 catalog the client owns. Folders are domain/feature with provenance ai-runtime, admin/ai, admin/chat, and adapter. Adapter is the only door into the Rust engine. Chat index paths now point at the D: tree.

Application UI is SvelteKit and Svelte 5. Svelte Flow graphs render catalog component ids. Routes and ai-runtime may call adapter. Catalog and tokens do not. component.json is discovered, not registered. Old /admin and /account HTML converts into this app.

UI folders use the kebab-case of existing Rust modules. calendar_event stays calendar_event in crates/jmap and becomes catalog/calendar-event. Adapter calls only the paths in crates/http/src/request.rs. Rust files are not renamed. No SvelteKit app is added to the workspace.

Existing screens login and calendar-rsvp now live in ui/ as Svelte 5. calendar-invite and calendar-alarm stay HTML mail bodies. Kernels are ui/src/lib/ai-runtime/mail, docs, and control-plane, each with threads. The engine still embeds the gzipped HTML until that static build is wired in. npm run check and npm run build in ui/ exited 0.
